about_the_game:
Story

"Echoes of Paur" tells the journey of a young adventurer searching for his missing grandfather on the mysterious Mount Paur. The mountain, shrouded in supernatural myths, holds dark secrets that go beyond personal loss. Each episode unravels new layers of the story, combining emotional depth with thrilling discoveries.

In Episode 1, Arshaka arrives in a remote village where his grandfather once lived, uncovering clues that lead to a dangerous path filled with supernatural beings, ancient rituals, and hostile adversaries. The stakes rise with each episode as Arshaka discovers his connection to the mountain's enigmatic history and the greater dangers that threaten not just him but the entire world. 

Gameplay

Exploration: Traverse dense jungles, eerie villages, and ancient ruins. Use tools and wit to unlock secrets and advance through challenges.

  • Survival: Resource management is crucial as you face supernatural threats, environmental hazards, and hostile foes.

  • Combat & Stealth: Engage in melee combat using traditional weapons or avoid enemies through stealth.

  • Puzzles & Mysteries: Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden artifacts, and decipher ancient scripts to progress.

  • Progression: Unlock abilities, tools, and deeper storylines with each episode.

The World

Immerse yourself in a world inspired by Indonesia's rich landscapes and cultural heritage. Each environment is designed with care to reflect the country's natural beauty and spiritual traditions, from serene waterfalls to ominous graveyards

content_descriptors.notes: There will be barehand fighting, melee weapon fighting, gunfights, which will produce red bloods, enemy dead, but there is no dismemberment of body parts

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 6600M
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for better performance
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 (8GB) / AMD Radeon RX 6800 (16GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires SSD for smooth streaming of assets
